title: Refresh Claude Engram eligibility for automatic Human queue starts after reload
outcome: After a host state reload, an automatic drain or activation can start a local root Claude for an already queued Human prompt before the declaration cache is warm. The launch omits Engram in an enabled, declared project. Apply the appropriate launch-local eligibility handling for these automatic routes while preserving queue ownership and retry behavior.
acceptance: With a persisted eligible local root Claude session and a queued Human prompt, automatic drain and exact activation build the scoped Engram descriptor when a fresh runtime starts after reload.
Unavailable declarations preserve the automatic route's queue ownership and recovery behavior, and the eligibility check leaves sibling runtimes untouched.
A behavior test covers this cold-cache start without requiring the earlier omission of Engram.
